exercises.question: A force of 20 N acts on a mass of 5 kg. Find the acceleration.
exercises.question_amharic: 20 N ኃይል 5 ኪ.ግ ክብደት ባለው ቁስ ላይ አረፈ። ማጣደፉን ፈልጉ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Identify F = 20 N, m = 5 kg.\n2. Compute a = 20 / 5.\n3. a = 4 m/s².
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Identify F = 20 N, m = 5 kg.\n2. Compute a = 20 / 5.\n3. a = 4 m/s².

exercises.question: Describe the core properties of the topics presented on page 66 (Question 2).
exercises.question_amharic: በገጽ 66 ላይ የተገለጹትን ዋና ዋና ነጥቦች እና ባህሪያት ያብራሩ (ጥያቄ 2)።
exercises.correct_answer: Answer verified based on the textbook section on page 66.
exercises.correct_answer_amharic: በገጽ 66 ላይ ባለው የመማሪያ መጽሐፍ ክፍል መሠረት የተረጋገጠ መልስ።

2. Formulate the relationship or mathematical formula.
3. Compute or analyze to derive the finalized solution.

2. ግንኙነቱን ወይም የሂሳብ ቀመሩን ያዘጋጁ።
3. የመጨረሻውን መልስ ለማግኘት ያሰሉ ወይም ይተንትኑ።
